message: Relation field "Left.rights" is an implicit many-to-many relation, but "Left" has a composite id; Prisma 7 requires a single-field @id on both models of an implicit many-to-many relation.
Relation field "Right.lefts" is an implicit many-to-many relation, but "Left" has a composite id; Prisma 7 requires a single-field @id on both models of an implicit many-to-many relation.
